description: This file defines an API endpoint for creating teams, including permission checks, database interactions, and Stripe checkout session generation.

methods.name: postHandler
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new team, including validation, permission checks, and payment processing.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin rights when creating a team with an ownerId.

methods.name: generateTeamCheckoutSession
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for pending team payment, including discount application and metadata.
